purpose: Compare original-source access, AI-mediated task-specific representation, and the same representation with optional advisory constraint inspection for substantial communication tasks.

arms.B: AI-mediated task-specific representation built from the source, with the same source and navigation available.
arms.C: B plus optional advisory constraint inspection (source-linked obligations and, where applicable, R6 typed constraints). Advisory only; no automatic routing.

controls.source_access: All arms receive the same original source bytes and the same navigation/retrieval capability.
controls.recipient: Same recipient model, same settings, isolated sessions, no expected answers or references.
controls.questions: Same questions, revealed only after the representation is generated.
controls.order: Counterbalance or randomise arm order; record order effects.
controls.contamination: Every source checked against R4/R5/R6/R7, LC-02 batch20 and Studio development cases before freezing.

planned_cases.task: apply a concept to a new example
distinguish what is said from what is implied

scoring.reference: Independent source-grounded reference answer with required atoms, conditions, uncertainty and acceptable alternatives.
scoring.correctness: Required atoms and relations present and correctly applied.
scoring.evidence: Each asserted atom has an exact source quotation or a traceable source span.
scoring.conditions: Conditions, exceptions and qualifiers preserved where the task requires them.
scoring.unsupported: Claims, permissions or causal links not supported by the source.
scoring.uncertainty: Genuine ambiguity preserved; invented doubt penalised.
scoring.selection: Relevant material included; irrelevant material does not crowd out the answer.
scoring.source_preferable: Exact quotation or provenance tasks must not be paraphrased away.

freeze_gate: Sources, tasks, references, arm definitions, model identities, order and criteria frozen before execution.
Overlap audit clean against every prior LC-02 corpus; no exact duplicates and no Jaccard >= 0.45.
Independent adjudication of references before any confirmatory claim.
No held-out case reused from LC-02 or from the LC-03 development fixture.
source_overlap_method: Source-token Jaccard plus exact-match check against R4/R5/R6/R7, LC-02 batch20 and Studio development cases.
note: This is a design plan, not an executed evaluation. No evaluation sources are authored or frozen here.
